title: publish refuses commit 1da4f4e3 for documentation-example email addresses no allowlist covers, so the public home cannot be updated
goal: The publish history scan (kbpublic.leak_verdicts, allowing each commit's own _tools/tests_allowlist.txt and the projection's) passes commits 73331d8a6e4f, 1da4f4e39b3e and f4190f0dbff1 of origin/main: the projection's allowlist gains one exact email line for each address 1da4f4e3 quoted and later text no longer carries, all documentation examples (Claude Code's fixed noreply attribution address under Anthropic's domain, and the two placeholder addresses of git's gitmailmap page under the email.xx domain); a hit that neither allowlist covers is still refused per commit, proven by one planted case in the existing publish leak test of _tools/test_publish_e2e.py within the test ceiling; kb/_self/git.md (Publish) says a value allowlisted later passes older commits. Code lane: the allowlist and test land through their code merge request.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import kbpublic as k; a=k.parse_allowlist(open(k.ALLOWLIST_PATH).read()); w=[(c,o,n,x) for r in ('73331d8a6e4f','1da4f4e39b3e','f4190f0dbff1') for c,ch in k.history_changes(r,r+'^','.') for s,o,n,x,m in ch if s!='D']; v=k.leak_verdicts(w,None,None,a,'.'); print(v); sys.exit(1 if v else 0)

notes: Premise (2026-10-20): the operator's publish --dry-run from the main checkout (branch orch/mac, 942 commits behind origin/main) refused 73331d8a6e4f, 1da4f4e39b3e and f4190f0dbff1. With origin/main's own tools only 1da4f4e3 is refused (the armor-label commits pass since BG-onc6wxd3's allowlist line); leak_verdicts already unions the commit's and the projection's allowlist, so the fix is the missing exact entries, not code.
